Prerequisite: Must have recon frame.

Light-warping and sound-dampening mechanisms enhance the mech's stealth capabilities.

@PPAbility[cost:0]{Fade} Gain concealment until you make an attack or take a harmful action.

@PPAbility[cost:4]{Cloak} Become invisible for 1 round. You can extend the duration by spending 1 PP per additional round.
